top_3_trending_topics: dramatic natural phenomena captured in extreme close‑up (e.g., massive sky shots, alive‑looking lightning)
simple but visually shocking experiments that defy expectations (e.g., lava river, matchstick battery)
mind‑bending space concepts that feel personal (e.g., wormholes, scary universe facts)
top_3_trending_hook_styles: Bold question + visual promise: "Why does this lightning look ALIVE?"
Shock‑value statement + emoji: "🔥 Amazing Matchstick & Battery Experiment 😱⚡"
Mystery teaser with a hook word: "This Is What a Wormhole Could Do to You! 🌌🤯"
market_pulse.best_performing_content_type: Shorts that combine a striking visual (explosion, extreme weather, or vivid experiment) with a concise "why does this happen?" hook, usually under 30 seconds.
market_pulse.viral_trigger: Instant visual shock paired with a curiosity‑driven question that promises a quick, surprising answer.

competitor_intelligence.their_secret: They film high‑speed or high‑contrast footage that reveals hidden details, then pair it with a single‑sentence hook that frames the clip as a mystery to be solved in seconds.
title_patterns: "[WHAT IF] + [SCENARIO]" (e.g., "What If a Wormhole Hit You?")
hook_patterns: Direct question + visual cue: "Did you see that?"
Mystery promise: "You won't believe what happens next..."
topics_they_avoid: Niche historical anecdotes without a visual hook
